description.narrative: The provision of a 3-year senior loan in the amount of up to US$ 2 million (in Kazakhstan tenge equivalent) to a Kazakh private leasing company TechnoLeasing LLC under the Financial Intermediaries Framework (FIF). The financing will be used by TL to finance assets to be leased to local private micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in Kazakhstan. The project will enable further lease financing to private Kazakh MSMEs by supporting continued growth of one of the largest private leasing company in the market. It will also help to diversify TL's funding base. The project aims to ensure prudent lending practices as the Company will be required to maintain the portfolio quality at an acceptable level.
